children.value: > Fact From Story: Sam Bankman-Fried, the founder of failed cryptocurrency exchange FTX, is on trial for seven counts of wire fraud and conspiracy.
> > Fact From Story: FTX was a fraud “from the start,” the Securities and Exchange Commission alleges — with a “multi-billion-dollar deficiency caused by his own misappropriation of customer funds.”
> > > Fact From Story: The government has indicated FTX co-founder Gary Wang and engineering head Nishad Singh will also be among the witnesses called to give testimony about Bankman-Fried.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Witnesses are called to testify in criminal trials.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Fraud and conspiracy are illegal.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Wire fraud and conspiracy are serious crimes.
